questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Crisis of the Mughal Empire' refers to.
questions.a: The era of administrative and financial decay in the imperial state after 1707, characterized by failing central oversight and the rise of local kingdoms.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Crisis of the Mughal Empire'.
questions.a: Decline of central authority due to wars, weak successors, and noble factions.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Crisis of the Mughal Empire' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: The Crisis of the Empire and the Later Mughals (source: gess108.txt lines 25-60)

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'External Invasions of the 18th Century' refers to.
questions.a: Military incursions by rulers from Iran and Afghanistan that resulted in the looting of the capital and the weakening of the sovereign's power.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'External Invasions of the 18th Century'.
questions.a: Foreign raids by Nadir Shah and Ahmad Shah Abdali drained Mughal wealth.

questions.q: Under which section is 'External Invasions of the 18th Century' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: The Crisis of the Empire and the Later Mughals (source: gess108.txt lines 70-100)

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Rajput Watan Jagirs' refers to.
questions.a: Semi-autonomous hereditary estates where local chieftains maintained governance while maintaining a formal link with the central throne.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Rajput Watan Jagirs'.
questions.a: Rajput rulers enjoyed internal autonomy in exchange for imperial service.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Rajput Watan Jagirs' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: The Rajputs (source: gess108.txt lines 120-150)

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Sikh Political Organization' refers to.
questions.a: The evolution of the Panth into a sovereign political body through the creation of the Khalsa and organized military units called misls.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Sikh Political Organization'.
questions.a: Transformation of Sikhs into a militant state-building community.

questions.q: Under which section is 'Sikh Political Organization' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: The Sikhs (source: gess108.txt lines 160-200)

questions.q: How much tax is paid under Rakhi? Use the method 'Rakhi System'. Work with: produce = 10. Carry the chain through step by step and give the final value of tax.
questions.a: 2 units

questions.q: Calculate the Rakhi tax for a produce of {produce}. Use the method 'Rakhi System'. Work with: produce = 30. Carry the chain through step by step and give the final value of tax.
questions.a: 6 units

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Rakhi System' refers to.
questions.a: A security arrangement where farmers provided one-fifth of their harvest to the Dal Khalsa for safety.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Rakhi System'.
questions.a: Protection tax levied by Sikh bands on cultivators.

questions.q: Write the standard relation used for 'Rakhi System', in plain ASCII form.
questions.a: tax = produce * 20 / 100

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'The Maratha State' refers to.
questions.a: A robust regional power established in the Deccan that used mobile warfare and specific levies to expand its influence across the subcontinent.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'The Maratha State'.
questions.a: Rise of Marathas under Shivaji and the Peshwas.

questions.q: Under which section is 'The Maratha State' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: The Marathas (source: gess108.txt lines 220-260)

questions.q: Calculate the chauth for a revenue of {revenue}. Use the method 'Chauth'. Work with: revenue = 120000. Carry the chain through step by step and give the final value of chauth.
questions.a: 30000 units

questions.q: Find the chauth tax when the revenue is {revenue}. Use the method 'Chauth'. Work with: revenue = 50000. Carry the chain through step by step and give the final value of chauth.
questions.a: 12500 units

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Chauth' refers to.
questions.a: A levy representing a quarter of the agricultural tax gathered by Maratha forces from neighboring regions.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Chauth'.
questions.a: Maratha tax consisting of 25 percent of land revenue.

questions.q: Write the standard relation used for 'Chauth', in plain ASCII form.
questions.a: chauth = revenue * 25 / 100

questions.q: Calculate the sardeshmukhi for a revenue of {revenue} at {rate} percent. Use the method 'Sardeshmukhi'. Work with: rate = 25, revenue = 120000. Carry the chain through step by step and give the final value of levy.
questions.a: 30000 units

questions.q: Find the sardeshmukhi levy for {revenue}. Use the method 'Sardeshmukhi'. Work with: rate = 18, revenue = 50000. Carry the chain through step by step and give the final value of levy.
questions.a: 9000 units

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'Sardeshmukhi' refers to.
questions.a: A supplementary charge of nine to ten percent given to the chief tax officer within the Deccan province.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'Sardeshmukhi'.
questions.a: Additional levy of 9-10 percent paid to the head revenue collector.

questions.q: Write the standard relation used for 'Sardeshmukhi', in plain ASCII form.
questions.a: levy = revenue * rate / 100

questions.q: Explain in your own words what 'The Jat State' refers to.
questions.a: A group of prosperous farmers who consolidated their influence near Delhi and Agra, eventually forming a fortified state at Bharatpur.

questions.q: State the single key point to remember about 'The Jat State'.
questions.a: Jat consolidation under Churaman and Suraj Mal.

questions.q: Under which section is 'The Jat State' taught, and from which source text?
questions.a: The Jats (source: gess108.txt lines 300-330)
